title: Mother Holding Swaddled Baby in Backyard, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-1940s outdoor snapshot depicting a young mother in profile cradling her swaddled infant bundled in a knitted blanket and bonnet. In the background, clothes hang drying on an outdoor clothesline next to a shingled residential home. The mother wears a classic 1940s rolled updo hairstyle. The print features distinct decorative deckled edges typical of mid-20th-century family photofinishing.
